purpose: Verify authorized student role is permitted to perform student OAP actions
preconditions: Student user is authenticated and holds student role
action_or_input: Student submits a leave application
expected_result: Action is authorized and leave application is created

purpose: Verify unauthorized role is denied access to student OAP submission function
preconditions: User is authenticated with faculty role without student privileges
action_or_input: User attempts to submit a student leave application
expected_result: Action is refused and no leave application is created

purpose: Verify student can access own OAP records
preconditions: Student A has submitted a leave application
action_or_input: Student A requests details of own leave application
expected_result: System returns student A's leave application data

purpose: Verify student cannot access another student's OAP records
preconditions: Student A has submitted a leave application; Student B is authenticated
action_or_input: Student B attempts to access Student A's leave application
expected_result: Request is refused or record is not found (404/403) and no data is leaked

purpose: Verify system-generated alert and email notification are queued on request submission
preconditions: Student submits a valid leave application
action_or_input: Submission event is processed
expected_result: Notification records for alert and email channels are created for the submission event

purpose: Verify alert and email notification are sent when HoD approves or rejects a request
preconditions: Leave application is submitted and pending HoD review
action_or_input: HoD records decision (Approved or Rejected)
expected_result: Notification records for alert and email channels are issued to the student

purpose: Verify notification is sent when all 7 no-dues authorities complete verification
preconditions: No-dues case has 6 clearances recorded
action_or_input: 7th authority records its clearance result
expected_result: System issues alert and email notification indicating verification completion

purpose: Verify notification is sent when approved/finalized certificate becomes available for download
preconditions: Bonafide request is approved or no-dues case is finalized
action_or_input: Approval/finalization transition completes
expected_result: System notifies requesting student via alert and email that certificate is available for download

purpose: Verify reminder is sent to responsible actor when pending-action reminder condition is met
preconditions: Action has been pending past configured reminder threshold
action_or_input: Pending-action reminder evaluation executes
expected_result: Reminder notification is issued to the responsible actor

purpose: Verify student can successfully submit a leave application
preconditions: Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Submit leave application with reason, from_date, and to_date
expected_result: Leave application is created in submitted state

purpose: Verify leave submission succeeds without supporting document
preconditions: Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Submit leave application with empty supporting document
expected_result: Leave application is created in submitted state with no document attached

purpose: Verify leave submission retains supporting document when provided
preconditions: Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Submit leave application with a supporting document link
expected_result: Leave application is created with the supporting document link retained

purpose: Verify submitted leave application is made available to the appropriate HoD
preconditions: Student submits leave application
action_or_input: HoD queries pending leave applications for student's department
expected_result: Submitted leave application is retrieved in HoD's queue

purpose: Verify HoD can view and review leave application and supporting documents
preconditions: Leave application submitted and available to HoD
action_or_input: HoD opens and views leave details and supporting document
expected_result: System presents leave application details and attached document link to HoD

purpose: Verify HoD can approve a submitted leave application
preconditions: Leave application is in submitted state
action_or_input: HoD submits Approve decision
expected_result: Leave application status transitions to Approved

purpose: Verify HoD can reject a submitted leave application
preconditions: Leave application is in submitted state
action_or_input: HoD submits Reject decision
expected_result: Leave application status transitions to Rejected

purpose: Verify student can track current status of submitted leave application
preconditions: Student has submitted leave application
action_or_input: Student queries leave tracking view
expected_result: System displays current status of the leave application

purpose: Verify student can view full leave application history
preconditions: Student has past approved and rejected leave applications
action_or_input: Student retrieves leave history
expected_result: System returns list of all past leave applications for the student

purpose: Verify student can submit a bonafide certificate request
preconditions: Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Student submits bonafide request with stated purpose
expected_result: Bonafide request is recorded in submitted state

purpose: Verify submitted bonafide request is available to Academic Administrator
preconditions: Bonafide request has been submitted by student
action_or_input: Academic Administrator queries pending bonafide requests
expected_result: Submitted bonafide request is present in Academic Administrator queue

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can verify a submitted bonafide request
preconditions: Bonafide request is submitted
action_or_input: Academic Administrator performs verification action
expected_result: Bonafide request verification is recorded with verifier ID and timestamp

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can approve a verified bonafide request
preconditions: Bonafide request is verified by Academic Administrator
action_or_input: Academic Administrator submits Approve decision
expected_result: Bonafide request status transitions to Approved

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can reject a bonafide request
preconditions: Bonafide request is submitted
action_or_input: Academic Administrator submits Reject decision
expected_result: Bonafide request status transitions to Rejected

purpose: Verify student can monitor status of bonafide request
preconditions: Student has submitted a bonafide request
action_or_input: Student queries bonafide request status
expected_result: Current status of the request is returned to the student

purpose: Verify student can download certificate after bonafide request is approved
preconditions: Bonafide request is in Approved state
action_or_input: Student requests bonafide certificate download
expected_result: Certificate access/download is granted

purpose: Verify student cannot download certificate prior to approval
preconditions: Bonafide request is in Submitted or Rejected state
action_or_input: Student attempts to download bonafide certificate
expected_result: Download is refused and no certificate is issued

purpose: Verify student can initiate a no-dues clearance request
preconditions: Student is authenticated and has no active open no-dues case
action_or_input: Student initiates no-dues clearance
expected_result: No-dues case is initiated with all 7 authorities routed in parallel

purpose: Verify no-dues clearance routes in parallel to all seven mandatory domains
preconditions: Student initiates no-dues clearance
action_or_input: Inspect created clearance records for the case
expected_result: Exactly seven domain clearance rows exist: Library, Hostel, Mess, Department, Lab, Academic Section, Student Section

purpose: Verify Librarian records clearance for Library domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; Librarian is authenticated
action_or_input: Librarian records Clear for Library domain
expected_result: Library domain result is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify Hostel Warden records clearance for Hostel domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; Hostel Warden is authenticated
action_or_input: Hostel Warden records Clear for Hostel domain
expected_result: Hostel domain result is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify Mess In-charge records clearance for Mess domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; Mess In-charge is authenticated
action_or_input: Mess In-charge records Clear for Mess domain
expected_result: Mess domain result is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify Lab Supervisor records clearance for Lab domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; Lab Supervisor is authenticated
action_or_input: Lab Supervisor records Clear for Lab domain
expected_result: Lab domain result is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify Department verifier records clearance for Department domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; Department verifier is authenticated
action_or_input: Department verifier records Clear for Department domain
expected_result: Department domain result is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify Academic Section verifier records clearance for Academic Section domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; Academic Section verifier is authenticated
action_or_input: Academic Section verifier records Clear for Academic Section domain
expected_result: Academic Section domain result is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify Student Section verifier records clearance for Student Section domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; Student Section verifier is authenticated
action_or_input: Student Section verifier records Clear for Student Section domain
expected_result: Student Section domain result is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify all seven domain clearance statuses are stored and maintained independently
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists
action_or_input: One authority updates its domain to Clear; query all domain statuses
expected_result: Only the updated domain changes state; the other 6 domains retain their previous states

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can review consolidated 7-domain results
preconditions: All 7 authorities have recorded results for a no-dues case
action_or_input: Academic Administrator opens consolidated case review
expected_result: All 7 domain clearance results are displayed in consolidated view

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can finalize no-dues clearance when all 7 domains are Clear
preconditions: All 7 domains have result Clear
action_or_input: Academic Administrator finalizes the no-dues case
expected_result: No-dues case transitions to Finalized state

purpose: Verify finalization is refused when any authority records dues outstanding or pending
preconditions: 6 domains are Clear, 1 domain is Outstanding or Pending
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to finalize no-dues case
expected_result: Finalization action is refused and case remains in progress

purpose: Verify student can track no-dues progress across all 7 clearance authorities
preconditions: Student has an active no-dues clearance case
action_or_input: Student retrieves no-dues progress
expected_result: System returns status breakdown for each of the seven authorities

purpose: Verify student can download no-dues certificate after finalization
preconditions: No-dues case is in Finalized state
action_or_input: Student requests no-dues certificate download
expected_result: Certificate access/download is granted

purpose: Verify student cannot download no-dues certificate before finalization
preconditions: No-dues case is in progress (not finalized)
action_or_input: Student attempts to download no-dues certificate
expected_result: Download is refused and no certificate is provided

purpose: Verify PG student can submit an assistantship claim
preconditions: Student has PG status and assigned supervisors
action_or_input: PG student submits assistantship claim
expected_result: Claim is created in submitted state

purpose: Verify submitted assistantship claim routes to both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor
preconditions: PG student submits assistantship claim
action_or_input: Inspect assigned verifiers on submitted claim
expected_result: Claim is routed to both the Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor

purpose: Verify Thesis Supervisor can record verification for an assistantship claim
preconditions: Claim is submitted; Thesis Supervisor is authenticated
action_or_input: Thesis Supervisor records verification for thesis role
expected_result: Thesis supervisor verification is recorded

purpose: Verify TA Supervisor can record verification for an assistantship claim
preconditions: Claim is submitted; TA Supervisor is authenticated
action_or_input: TA Supervisor records verification for TA role
expected_result: TA supervisor verification is recorded

purpose: Verify claim is not available to Department Administrator until both supervisor verifications are complete
preconditions: Claim has only one supervisor verification recorded
action_or_input: Department Administrator queries pending claims for review
expected_result: Claim is not available in Department review queue

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can review claim after both supervisor verifications complete
preconditions: Both Thesis and TA supervisor verifications are recorded
action_or_input: Department Administrator opens claim for review
expected_result: Claim details and supervisor verifications are visible to Department Administrator

purpose: Verify Department Administrator forwards reviewed assistantship claim to HoD
preconditions: Claim is reviewed by Department Administrator
action_or_input: Department Administrator executes Forward to HoD
expected_result: Claim is forwarded and made available to HoD

purpose: Verify HoD can approve an assistantship claim forwarded by Department Administrator
preconditions: Claim is forwarded to HoD
action_or_input: HoD submits Approve decision
expected_result: Claim status transitions to Approved

purpose: Verify HoD can reject an assistantship claim forwarded by Department Administrator
preconditions: Claim is forwarded to HoD
action_or_input: HoD submits Reject decision
expected_result: Claim status transitions to Rejected

purpose: Verify HoD-approved claim becomes available to Academic Administrator for stipend processing
preconditions: Claim is approved by HoD
action_or_input: Academic Administrator queries pending stipend disbursement claims
expected_result: Approved claim appears in Academic Administrator stipend processing queue

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator can process stipend disbursement for HoD-approved claim
preconditions: Claim is approved by HoD
action_or_input: Academic Administrator processes stipend disbursement
expected_result: Stipend disbursement is recorded as processed for the claim

purpose: Verify PG student can track assistantship claim across its processing stages
preconditions: PG student has submitted an assistantship claim
action_or_input: PG student queries assistantship claim tracking
expected_result: Current stage and verification history of the claim are returned

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record a thesis-supervisor assignment
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record thesis-supervisor assignment associating PG student with faculty supervisor
expected_result: Thesis supervisor assignment is persisted and active

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record TA assignment with course/subject only
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record TA assignment associating PG student with a course code and no faculty
expected_result: TA assignment is successfully recorded with course code

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record TA assignment with faculty member only
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record TA assignment associating PG student with a faculty member and no course
expected_result: TA assignment is successfully recorded with supervisor faculty

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record TA assignment with both course and faculty
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record TA assignment associating PG student with both a course code and faculty member
expected_result: TA assignment is successfully recorded with both course and supervisor

purpose: Verify PG student can initiate a request for graduate seminar scheduling
preconditions: Student holds PG status
action_or_input: PG student submits graduate seminar scheduling request
expected_result: Seminar request is created in awaiting_scheduling state

purpose: Verify seminar scheduling request is available to Department Administrator
preconditions: PG student has submitted a seminar scheduling request
action_or_input: Department Administrator queries pending seminar requests
expected_result: Submitted seminar request appears in Department Administrator queue

purpose: Verify Department Administrator can schedule a graduate seminar
preconditions: Seminar request is in awaiting_scheduling state
action_or_input: Department Administrator records scheduled_for datetime and venue
expected_result: Seminar schedule is created and request status transitions to Scheduled

purpose: Verify system maintains history/log of graduate seminar scheduling records
preconditions: Seminar has been scheduled by Department Administrator
action_or_input: Query seminar scheduling history or audit event log
expected_result: Scheduling history event is retrievable and unchanged

purpose: Verify PG students and faculty members can view scheduled graduate seminars
preconditions: Scheduled graduate seminars exist
action_or_input: PG student or faculty member retrieves seminar schedule list
expected_result: List of scheduled graduate seminars is returned with venue and datetime
